lines.t: Every summer I see the strangest things,
Little sprouts poppin’ up with no strings.
Didn’t plant no seeds, at least not here,
But something funky’s growing every year.
Maybe the birds had a garden plan,
Or the raccoons formed a compost clan.
They’re planting crops like undercover spies,
In my garden, it’s a veggie surprise!
Oh, it’s the mystery garden boogie,
The compost makes it groovy.
From cherry toms to melons sweet,
Don’t know what’s poppin’ up by my feet!
Yeah, the mystery garden boogie,
It’s growin’ wild and loopy.
Maybe next year I’ll find a tree,
That’s half a squash, half a kiwi!
One summer came a cantaloupe vine,
Next year a watermelon looked mighty fine.
Now I’ve got a cucumber melon blend,
Natures humor just won’t end.
Critters playin’ farmer all night long,
Tossin’ seeds where they don’t belong.
Every pot a science fair show,
Will it be a fruit or veggie? I don’t know!
Oh, it’s the mystery garden boogie,
The compost makes it groovy.
From cherry toms to melons sweet,
Don’t know what’s poppin’ up by my feet!
Yeah, the mystery garden boogie,
With veggies all mixed and cooky.
Guess it’s nature’s way to say,
“Why plan a garden anyway?”
Got my shovel, got my hat,
Waiting to see what sprouts from that.
Could be dinner, could be art,
Could be a salad with a mystery heart!
Oh, the mystery garden boogie,
Nature’s prank’s a doozy.
From cucu-melons to who-knows-what,
I’m just rollin’ with the compost plot!
Yeah, the mystery garden boogie,
It’s wild, weird, and moody.
Sing it loud, plant it proud,
That’s my mystery garden crowd!
